notes.title: A First Look At Mouse: P.I. For Hire—Rubber Hose and Rubber Bullets
notes.content:
It should probably go without saying that when I first saw Mouse: P.I. For Hire—initially just titled Mouse—I was immediately intrigued. It was another one of those games that found its way across one of my socials, and I loved what it was doing. I’ve mentioned before that I’ve come to really enjoy the combination of 2D characters in 3D environments, seen in games like Demon Turf, Ruff and the Riverside and Forgive Me Father. But Mouse: P.I. For Hire was really taking it to the next level.

With Summer Game Fest being as crazy as it is, CGM was unable to sit down with Fumi Games personally to take a more in-depth look at Mouse: P.I. For Hire, however, the team was gracious enough to share with us some first-look footage of the game in action and I’ve got to say—its quite an evolution. What started as a fairly simple shooter with an incredible aesthetic has transformed into something wildly creative and seriously inventive.

notes.title: Troy Baker is Jack Pepper | Summer Game Fest Trailer
notes.content: [previewyoutube="2QhWXpfjBjQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We are excited to announce that globally renowned actor Troy Baker (known for his performances in [i]The Last of Us[/i], [i]Indiana Jones and the Great Circle[/i], [i]BioShock Infinite[/i], and more) has been cast as the leading character in [b]MOUSE: P.I. For Hire[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]As revealed during Summer Game Fest, Baker will play Private Investigator Jack Pepper - the game’s lead protagonist - a former war hero, now a detective in a world where danger lurks in the smallest mouse hole. His journey starts with a seemingly cliché damsel in distress, but as P.I. Pepper begins to scratch the surface of Mouseburg’s seedy underbelly, it quickly spirals into a complex web of intrigue, involving murder, corruption and the unlikeliest of enemies.[/p][p][/p][p]MOUSE: P.I. For Hire is planned for release this year. Wishlist now and follow to stay up to date on all future developments![/p]

notes.title: News This Week From Mouseburg
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44082804/fafba154e6833983f555044b315f1ac4cd335a0f.png[/img]
Hey everyone,

We have some exciting news to share about MOUSE: P.I. For Hire in the coming week, but we want to clarify ahead of time that this will not include our release date.

Our goal is still to launch MOUSE: P.I. For Hire this year, and we are working tirelessly to make that happen. Making the best game that we can is our highest priority and we won’t announce a release date until we know that the game is ready. Until then, we will continue to share more updates on the game's development (including some fun behind the scenes), so please stay tuned over the coming months!

Your love, support and patience mean the world to us, and we can’t thank you enough for everything. See you soon 🐭

- Fumi Games & PlaySide

[previewyoutube=4nt4dqP9wtQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Live out your sci-fi dreams with these “experimental” weapons, each providing a unique but devastating way of taking down Mouseburg’s seedy underbelly:
[list]
[*] [b]CLEAN-D Automatic Turpentine Cleanser [/b]- The Turpentine Gun: A must-have for every household, the Turpentine Gun is capable of literally erasing the harshest of “stains”, with its patented mixture of toxins and corrosive design. Clean up the streets of Mouseburg with this nifty appliance!

[*] [b]COOL-D Cold Steam Applier[/b] - The Freeze Gun: Stay frosty with the Freeze Gun, an icy device that can keep your cheese fresh and freeze your foes in place (side effects may include accidental shattering). Forget the ice box and be one of the first in the world to try out its arctic breeze!

notes.title: Extra! Extra! A brand new trailer!
notes.content:
A clue; a lead; what more could a Mouse Detective want? How about a new gameplay trailer reveal? Eureka! Our latest gameplay trailer reveals more of our handcrafted gameplay, as you step into the paws of Private Investigator Jack Pepper on a guns-blazing adventure through the seedy criminal underbelly of Mouseburg. Utilize an assorted arsenal of weapons, power-ups and explosives as you unravel the city’s dark secrets and embark on a quest for justice. 

[previewyoutube=k_LhhhRHWBw;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] [b]Iconic Style:[/b] The monochromatic, hand-drawn rubber hose animation and original retro jazz soundtrack are created with the same techniques of the era. The playful weaponry, whimsical health display, and cartoon chaos add a light-hearted twist to each death.

[*] [b]Customizable Power-Ups: [/b]Enhance melee combat with a can of Spike-D Spinach, or even attach Pepper’s mouse tail to a Grappling Hook to rapidly traverse Mouseberg’s rooftops.

[*] [b]Fast-paced Action: [/b]Discover and combine powerful upgrades with comical weapons to violently blow apart enemies. From crackling Tommy guns to explosive firepower, use a mix of combat styles that adjust to play style preferences to defeat enemies in epic fights and challenging boss battles. 

[*] [b]A City of Danger:[/b] Join Jack Pepper’s diverse city playground spanning a movie studio, dockland, casino, swamp marshland, and underground sewer network locations. But beware of what lurks beneath the surface! Embark on a gripping detective adventure and encounter a mischievous cast of big bads as Pepper takes a gritty journey to the dark side of town.

[*][b] Solve the Mystery:[/b] Earn rewards from minigames and side quests as Jack Pepper uncovers clues and collectibles that pay homage to iconic pop culture, films, and cartoons.

notes.title: Join P.I. Pepper for his next investigation in Mouseburg
notes.content:
We’re beyond excited to finally reveal the official title for MOUSE: P.I. For Hire - and our brand new trailer, which - as always - showcases some of our recent development progress on the game!

[previewyoutube=8-ueTky6eEk;full][/previewyoutube]

Our latest trailer begins to scratch the surface of the darker side of Mouseburg’s seedy underbelly, and shows a sneak peak at some of the hand-crafted biomes players will get to explore at launch next year:
[list]
[*][b]Marina[/b] - Mouseburg’s Port and Dock district. It’s seen better economic times.
[*][b]Film Studio[/b] - Mouseburg’s premiere movie studio, home to various unique set locations
[*][b]Swamps[/b] - Mouseburg’s marshlands. Beware what lurks beneath the surface!
[*][b]Sewers[/b] - An vast underground system of subway tunnels and sewers, and home to Mouseburg’s moonshine transport network.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44082804/eebdbabae89b7c93cb1a2d57cd654f78292c2cd9.jpg[/img]

We’ve also included a look at some of the exciting new weapons we’ve added to the game over the past few months - and the bespoke, hand-drawn animations we’ve created for each:
[list]
[*][b]The Mauser[/b] - A classic, multishot pistol and P.I. Pepper’s trusty right hand
[*][b]The Shotgun[/b]- Single barreled, six-shot, pump-action destruction
[*][b]The Tommy Gun[/b] - The Mouseberg Typewriter; a mobster’s best friend
[*][b]The Lewis Gun[/b] - A heavy machine gun capable of mowing down Mouseburg’s crooks
[*][b]The Turpentine Gun[/b] - A handy tool for literally erasing enemies 
[*][b]The Camera[/b] - The Private Investigator’s sidekick, used for documenting evidence[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44082804/db350ee998db06998c6ab1974f79da8c91b64bb7.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned for some exciting MOUSE: P.I. For Hire news in the next few months, and make sure to join our [url=bit.ly/MOUSEDiscord]official Discord server[/url] and follow MOUSE on social for regular development updates!

—

notes.title: Nothing says YOU more than a can of healthy spinach!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44082804/4c0178c967ec1c728b1b75903e3ec0ce68f45e0f.png[/img]

We’re incredibly excited to share some of the latest MOUSE gameplay systems and mechanics in development - revealed today during the [url=https://iii-initiative.com/]Triple-i Initiative[/url] Showcase!


[previewyoutube=LwD_h0OQFfQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]“In a brave, new world, anyone can be whoever they want to be. And nothing says YOU more than a can of healthy spinach! Spike-D Spinach – now with a special, secret ingredient! Kids, remember your five a day!”[/i]

Our latest gameplay teaser showcases some of the unique weapons and environmental transversal options in development, including:
[list]
[*] [b]Grappling Hook[/b] - Enables attachment to designated points for rapid movement and traversal.
[*] [b]Helicopter[/b] - Reduces descent speed and facilitates extended aerial traversal.
[*] [b]PowerUp Spinach[/b] - Used to augment and enhance melee gameplay.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44082804/20dd7e19bcc5e5b9718e27974118658019dfd14f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44082804/52c5affe2122c695714151ed6ac71c5f8042f1de.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44082804/a5bf86d373930476a4ef0dac6d59deb1709b3c4d.png[/img]

We can’t wait to share more development details over the coming months! Alongside the new gameplay, we have also launched our brand new [url=https://discord.com/invite/tbYfWm6YCs]official Discord server.[/url] We want to hear from you over the course of development - so jump in and let us know your thoughts!


[i]‘MOUSE is incredibly important to all of us here at Fumi Games, and we’re committed to making sure that it lives up to expectations. Our goal has always been to create a game that combines our passion for animation with our passion for first-person shooters. We are genuinely committed to collaborating closely with the MOUSE community to craft a game that truly resonates with players. We'll aim to share more details - whenever possible - as development progresses. Our partner PlaySide and our dedicated and talented team is working hard to bring you the finest grandboomer cartoon shooter ever created!’[/i]

Mateusz Michalak, CEO of Fumi Games
